title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：theme　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 theme 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the painter ① chose the theme that no visitor in the studio would have described, and he said the choosing was the whole of the season. The ② theme, meaning the subject itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a theme, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ theme in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ theme at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A theme, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the painter said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the theme was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the subject. The ⑥ theme, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; theme, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a subject and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ theme had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ theme of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of describing; theme, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ theme I remember is the subject described in the catalogue, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ theme, my mother said in 1974, is the only subject that improves by being described; every theme, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a subject. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 主题（指画室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 主题（指那个主题本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the theme 选定这一个主题
D. n. 主题（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 主题之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的主题之事）
F. n. 主题（指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一个）
G. n. 主题、主旨（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 主旨（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the theme that no visitor in the studio would have described
The theme, meaning the subject itself and not the brush
the theme at the far easel
the theme was the whole of the matter
the theme had become a line in a catalogue
The theme of the whole thing
A theme, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: choose the theme 意为“选定这一个主题”，1965 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯描述的一个主题做了一遍。
theme 意为“主题”，指那个主题本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被描述。
theme 意为“主题”，指画室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
theme 意为“主题”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
theme 意为“主题、主旨”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个主旨就是那件事的全部。
theme 意为“主旨”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个主题，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
theme 意为“主题”，指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1970 年这一个成了展品目录里的一行。
theme 意为“主题之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的主题之事是一处画室和三个季度的描述。
theme 意为“主题”，我记得的是展品目录里描述过的那一个，1972 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一个。
theme 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，主题是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的主题。
